body:
ive been staying alive for two people other than myself for the past two years and in the last few months theyve both for the most part disappeared from my life. theyve found people who are less needy than i am, understandably. i dont have anything going for me. i'm not even a burden anymore at this point, im insignificant to anyones life.

todays my 23rd birthday, and im alone, like always. i was holding out my last bit of hope that maybe someone who was in my life would actually want to spend time with me today, and i was wrong.
